title: Country Sunrise ABC
hook: A-B-C—the whole farm starts to glow.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: two supportive beats between cue and answer
visualStyle: gentle 3D countryside storybook, sunrise gold, soft green fields, friendly rounded animals and objects, uncluttered

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a quiet child observer watching one farm change as sunlight travels across the day
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: mark the passage of light without turning the calm song into a high-energy reset
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written time-of-day imagery with sparse rhyme, assonance and long breathing space; facts are embedded in light, shadow, texture and movement
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: soft light cue -> two-beat recall space -> target -> restrained gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. fiddle or woodblock answers after the target, with a warm porch pulse
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: fiddle or woodblock answers after the target, with a warm porch pulse
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Let changing daylight be the composer: the same farm is revealed differently at dawn, noon, afternoon and evening, giving the alphabet a calm emotional arc.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A quiet observer follows light, shadow, dew, warmth and silhouette instead of narrating chores; rhyme is sparse and image-led.
semanticArc: first gold reveals the quiet farm
last silhouettes settle at day end
forbiddenGenericLanguage: country words wake up with me
